name: Dwarf
description: Medium humanoid (dwarf). +2 Con, -2 Cha. Darkvision 60 ft. and stonecunning. Racial bonuses against poison, magic, orcs, goblinoids, and giants.

ability.name: Darkvision 60 ft.
ability.description: Dwarves can see in the dark up to 60 feet. Darkvision is black and white only but otherwise like normal sight.

ability.name: Stonecunning
ability.description: +2 racial bonus on Search checks to notice unusual stonework (sliding walls, traps, new construction, shaky ceilings, etc.). A dwarf within 10 ft. of unusual stonework may Search as if actively searching. Can intuit approximate depth underground.

ability.name: Weapon Familiarity
ability.description: Dwarves may treat dwarven waraxes and dwarven urgroshes as martial weapons rather than exotic weapons.

ability.name: Stability
ability.description: +4 racial bonus on ability checks to resist being bull rushed or tripped while standing on the ground.

ability.name: Poison Resistance
ability.description: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against poison.

ability.name: Magic Resistance
ability.description: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against spells and spell-like effects.

ability.name: Enmity vs. Orcs and Goblinoids
ability.description: +1 racial bonus on attack rolls against orcs and goblinoids.

ability.name: Dodge Giants
ability.description: +4 dodge bonus to Armor Class against monsters of the giant type. Lost any time the dwarf would lose his Dexterity bonus to AC.

ability.name: Appraise (Stone/Metal)
ability.description: +2 racial bonus on Appraise checks related to stone or metal items.

ability.name: Craft (Stone/Metal)
ability.description: +2 racial bonus on Craft checks related to stone or metal.

name: Elf
description: Medium humanoid (elf). +2 Dex, -2 Con. Immunity to magic sleep effects, low-light vision, racial skill bonuses on Listen/Search/Spot, and bonus weapon proficiencies.

ability.name: Enchantment Resistance
ability.description: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against enchantment spells or effects.

ability.name: Low-Light Vision
ability.description: An elf can see twice as far as a human in starlight, moonlight, torchlight, and similar conditions of poor illumination, retaining color and detail.

ability.name: Weapon Proficiency
ability.description: Elves receive Martial Weapon Proficiency for the longsword, rapier, longbow (including composite longbow), and shortbow (including composite shortbow) as bonus feats.

ability.name: Passive Secret-Door Detection
ability.description: An elf passing within 5 ft. of a secret or concealed door is entitled to a Search check as if actively looking for it.

name: Gnome
description: Small humanoid (gnome). +2 Con, -2 Str. Low-light vision, racial bonuses against illusions, giants, kobolds, and goblinoids, plus innate spell-like abilities.

ability.name: Low-Light Vision
ability.description: A gnome can see twice as far as a human in starlight, moonlight, torchlight, and similar conditions of poor illumination, retaining color and detail.

ability.name: Weapon Familiarity
ability.description: Gnomes may treat gnome hooked hammers as martial weapons rather than exotic weapons.

ability.name: Illusion Resistance
ability.description: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against illusions.

ability.name: Illusion DC +1
ability.description: +1 to the DC of all saving throws against illusion spells cast by a gnome. Stacks with similar effects.

ability.name: Enmity vs. Kobolds and Goblinoids
ability.description: +1 racial bonus on attack rolls against kobolds and goblinoids.

ability.name: Dodge Giants
ability.description: +4 dodge bonus to Armor Class against monsters of the giant type. Lost any time the gnome would lose his Dexterity bonus to AC.

ability.name: Craft (Alchemy)
ability.description: +2 racial bonus on Craft (alchemy) checks.

name: Half-Elf
description: Medium humanoid (elf). Immunity to magic sleep effects, low-light vision, and racial skill bonuses on Listen/Search/Spot and Diplomacy/Gather Information.

ability.name: Enchantment Resistance
ability.description: +2 racial bonus on saving throws against enchantment spells or effects.

ability.name: Low-Light Vision
ability.description: A half-elf can see twice as far as a human in starlight, moonlight, torchlight, and similar conditions of poor illumination, retaining color and detail.

ability.name: Elven Blood
ability.description: For all effects related to race, a half-elf is considered an elf.

name: Half-Orc
description: Medium humanoid (orc). +2 Str, -2 Int, -2 Cha. Darkvision 60 ft. and counts as an orc for race-related effects.

ability.name: Darkvision 60 ft.
ability.description: Half-orcs can see in the dark up to 60 feet. Darkvision is black and white only but otherwise like normal sight.

ability.name: Orc Blood
ability.description: For all effects related to race, a half-orc is considered an orc.

name: Halfling
description: Small humanoid (halfling). +2 Dex, -2 Str. Racial skill bonuses on Climb/Jump/Move Silently/Listen, +1 on all saves, +2 morale vs. fear, and +1 with thrown/sling attacks.

ability.name: Lucky
ability.description: +1 racial bonus on all saving throws.

ability.name: Fearless
ability.description: +2 morale bonus on saving throws against fear. Stacks with the halfling's +1 bonus on saves in general.

ability.name: Thrown Weapon Mastery
ability.description: +1 racial bonus on attack rolls with thrown weapons and slings.
